cases.title: Select available seat and movie to update total price and count
cases.description: Verify that clicking an available seat marks it as selected, updates the selected count element (data-testid='selected-count'), and calculates the total price in (data-testid='total-price') as the number of selected seats multiplied by the selected movie's price from the dropdown (data-testid='movie-select').

cases.title: Click on occupied seat prevents selection and price change
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a seat marked with the occupied class does not select it, and does not alter the selected seat count or total price.

cases.title: Dynamic movie change updates total price correctly
cases.description: Verify that changing the selected movie in the dropdown after seats have already been selected dynamically recalculates and updates the total price based on the new movie price while keeping the selected seat count constant.

cases.title: Select Movie and Available Seat with LocalStorage Update (Normal)
cases.description: Verify that selecting a movie from the dropdown updates the price and clicking an available seat toggles its selection status, updates the count and total price, and stores the seat indices in localStorage.

cases.title: Deselect Previously Selected Seat (Edge)
cases.description: Verify that clicking a previously selected seat deselects it, removes it from localStorage, and appropriately decreases the seat count and total price.

cases.title: Attempt to Select Occupied Seat (Error/Abnormal)
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a seat marked as 'occupied' does not change its selection status, does not include it in localStorage, and does not affect the seat count or total price.

cases.title: Load Page with Existing Local Storage Values
cases.description: Verify that when local storage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the system successfully retrieves them upon page load, marks the corresponding seats with the 'selected' class, and sets the movie dropdown to the correct option.

cases.title: Load Page with Empty Local Storage
cases.description: Verify that when local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' upon page load, and the movie dropdown defaults to the first movie option, 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Dynamic calculation of selected count and total price
cases.description: Verify that when a user selects available seats and a movie from the dropdown, the element with data-testid='selected-count' updates correctly and the element with data-testid='total-price' reflects the product of selected seats and the movie price.

cases.title: Deselection of seats and changing movie selection
cases.description: Verify that deselecting a previously selected seat decreases the count and total price accordingly, and changing the movie selection after seats are selected updates the total price based on the new ticket price while maintaining the selected seat count.

cases.title: Prevention of selecting occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that the system prevents users from selecting seats marked as 'occupied', ensuring that clicking them does not alter the selected seat count or total price.

cases.title: Normal - Distinguish seat statuses via legends and toggle available seats
cases.description: Verify that users can distinguish between available, selected, and occupied seats using status legends, and that clicking an available seat toggles its selection while correctly updating the selected count and total price.

cases.title: Edge - Deselect previously selected seats
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a previously selected seat deselects it and updates the selected count and total price accordingly.

cases.title: Error - Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that occupied seats are non-interactive, clearly marked, and clicking them does not alter their status or affect the selected count and total price.

opinions.feedback: All requirements are thoroughly covered with distinct test cases addressing normal, edge, and error scenarios. No blockers found.

analysis.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1: Normal path includes selecting an available seat and choosing a movie to update total price and selected count. Edge boundary includes clicking an occupied seat which must not be selectable and should not affect count or price. Abnormal path includes changing movie selection dynamically and verifying price updates correctly. For requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2: Normal path covers selecting predefined movies ('The Big Lebowski', 'Fargo', etc.) and toggling seat selection with localStorage persistence. Edge boundary includes deselecting previously selected seats by clicking again. Abnormal path covers attempting to click occupied seats. For requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3: Normal path covers loading page with valid 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex' in localStorage. Edge boundary covers loading page when localStorage is empty, defaulting to no selected seats and the first movie. For requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4: Normal path covers calculating total price as product of selected count and movie price, and updating when movie changes. Edge boundary covers deselecting seats to decrease count and price. Abnormal path covers preventing selection of occupied seats. For requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5: Normal path covers distinguishing seat statuses via legends and toggling available seats while updating count and price.
